,su1.U_Name AS pProjectManagerName ,su1.U_ID AS pProjectManager ,su2.U_Name AS pEngineerName ,su2.U_ID AS pEngineer
,COALESCE(gt.lcbLq,0) AS lcbLq ,COALESCE(gt.yjLq,0) AS yjLq ,COALESCE(gt.ejLq,0) AS ejLq ,COALESCE(gt.lcbLq,0) + COALESCE(gt.yjLq,0) + COALESCE(gt.ejLq,0) AS lqCount ,COALESCE(gt.yqCount,0) AS yqCount
,COALESCE(gt.ywcCount,0) ,COALESCE(gt.wwcCount,0) ,CASE WHEN gt.ywcCount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(gt.wwcCount * 100.0 / gt.ywcCount, 2) END AS wwcRate

tk.Task_Importance = '99' AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{conf.milestone} DAY)) OR (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NOT NULL AND tk.Task_Importance = '99' AND (tk.Must_Handle = 0 OR tk.Must_Handle IS NULL) AND ( (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NULL AND tk.Task_Importance = '01' AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS yjLq, SUM( CASE WHEN tk.Task_Finish_Time IS NULL AND tk.task_state != 0 AND (tk.Must_Handle = 0 OR tk.Must_Handle IS NULL) AND ( (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NULL AND tk.Task_Importance = '02' AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{conf.secondLevel} DAY)) OR (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NOT NULL AND tk.Task_Importance = '02' AND DATE(tk.Task_End_Date) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{conf.secondLevel} DAY)) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS ejLq, SUM( CASE WHEN tk.Task_Finish_Time IS NULL AND tk.task_state != 0 AND (tk.Must_Handle = 0 OR tk.Must_Handle IS NULL) AND ( (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) < CURDATE()) OR (tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_End_Date) < CURDATE()) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS yqCount, SUM( CASE WHEN tk.task_state != 0 AND (tk.Must_Handle = 0 OR tk.Must_Handle IS NULL) AND ( (tk.Task_Start_Date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) <= CURDATE()) OR (tk.Task_End_Date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_End_Date) <= CURDATE()) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS ywcCount, SUM( CASE WHEN (tk.Task_Finish_Time IS NULL or tk.Task_Begin_Time IS NULL) AND (tk.Must_Handle = 0 OR tk.Must_Handle IS NULL) AND tk.task_state != 0 AND ( (tk.Task_Start_Date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_Start_Date) <= CURDATE()) OR (tk.Task_End_Date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tk.Task_End_Date) <= CURDATE()) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS wwcCount FROM Gantt_Tasks tk GROUP BY tk.PLAN_ID ) gt ON gt.PLAN_ID = mn.PLAN_ID

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lgtp.Gtp_State = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS alreadyOver, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lgtp.Gtp_State NOT IN (0,3,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS underApproval, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gt.Must_Handle = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mustHandle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gt.task_importance = '99' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS milestoneCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gt.task_importance = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS firstLevelCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gt.task_importance = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS secondLevelCount FROM Gantt_Tasks gt JOIN Gantt_Plan mn ON mn.Plan_Id = gt.Plan_Id JOIN Pre_Project pro ON pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p1.Task_Id, p1.Gtp_State FROM Gantt_Tasks_Process p1 LEFT JOIN Gantt_Tasks_Process p2 ON p2.Task_Id = p1.Task_Id AND ( p2.Gtp_upload_times > p1.Gtp_upload_times OR (p2.Gtp_upload_times = p1.Gtp_upload_times AND p2.Gtp_Id > p1.Gtp_Id) ) WHERE p2.Task_Id IS NULL ) lgtp ON lgtp.Task_Id = gt.Task_Id ${params.authSql}
